summary: BLOCKED: Vendor login for ali@gmail.com / 1234567890 is rejected by the external backend (network-pay-1.emergent.host) with HTTP 401 'Invalid credentials'. Frontend correctly displays 'Invalid credentials' error. Was unable to execute any runtime UI tests for the 9 requested features because every requested screen (/vendor/erp, /vendor/pos, /vendor/sales, /vendor/invoices, /vendor/customers) requires an authenticated vendor session. Performed a thorough code review of all 6 referenced files and every requested change is present and correctly implemented in the source — see critical_code_review_comments below.

critical.issue: ali@gmail.com / 1234567890 returns 401 'Invalid credentials'. This is the ONLY vendor account listed in /app/memory/test_credentials.md as 'WORKING' for POS/Sales/Orders testing. Admin (support@slangcart.com) still works but is not a vendor and cannot exercise /vendor/pos, /vendor/erp, vendor invoices, etc. Iteration_22 previously passed 100% with these same creds, so the upstream account state changed after that run.

action_items: Get ali@gmail.com vendor password reset on the external backend, OR provision a new vendor test account and update /app/memory/test_credentials.md, then re-run this batch of tests.
Consider seeding a local-backend vendor fallback so vendor UI can be smoke-tested when the external upstream is unavailable.
critical_code_review_comments: T1 ErpNav (frontend/src/components/erp/ErpNav.jsx): ITEMS array correctly contains ONLY the 6 required tabs (GST Hub, Purchase Book, Smart GST, Roles & Staff, Owner Settings, Learn). The forbidden tabs (Product Master, Inventory, Accounts, Reminders, Income Tax, Reports, Audit Log) are NOT in the nav array. PASS by code inspection.

T2 POS commission (VendorPOS.jsx line 316-326 + vendorSales.js computeTotals lines 101-149): data-testid pos-comm-<idx> present between GST and Total columns. computeTotals adds commission to display_subtotal (subtotal+commissionTotal) and adds an equal amount to discount_total (line 146: round2(discTotal + billDiscount + commissionTotal)); grand_total math ignores commission because commissionTotal cancels out. For price 100, gst 0%, comm 3%: subtotal=100, commissionTotal=3, display_subtotal=103, discount_total=3, grand_total=100. Totals card renders Subtotal (display_subtotal), 'Commission' row when >0 (line 346), 'Discount' row when discount_total>0 (line 347), and pos-grand-total (line 351). PASS by code inspection.
T3 GST dropdown (VendorPOS.jsx line 305-313): pos-gst-<idx> is a <select> with GST_SLABS=[0,5,12,18,28,40] options. pos-gst-inclusive checkbox retained on line 242. PASS by code inspection.

T4 Select saved customer (VendorPOS.jsx lines 373-392): pos-cust-select button rendered only when customerBook.length > 0. pos-cust-book-select dropdown shows saved customer, picking sets customer state to kind:'named' with fields populated. saveCustomer in vendorSales.js dedupes by phone/name. PASS by code inspection.

T5 Sales payments no credit (VendorSales.jsx line 21): PAY_KEYS = ['cash','upi','debit','wallet'] — 'credit' intentionally excluded. vs-pay-<k> tiles rendered from PAY_KEYS (line 627-637). displayPayLabel (line 31-38) returns 'COD' / 'Wallet' / 'Online' for online orders. Recent table & drilldown uppercase invoice_no via .toUpperCase() (lines 85, 104, 299, 674). PASS by code inspection.

T6 Duplicate invoice fix (vendorSales.js createInvoice lines 154-185): cloud-mirror side effect was removed with a clear comment; POS invoices are localStorage-only. VendorSales.jsx line 478-482 and VendorInvoices.jsx line 93-95 also dedupe by cloud_id and invoice_no as a defence-in-depth. PASS by code inspection.

T7 Refund password gate (VendorInvoices.jsx lines 118-131): window.prompt for owner password, POST apiLocal /erp/owner-security/verify, on 4xx it alert()s and aborts; on success it prompts for reason and calls refundInvoice. Line 239 gates the vi-refund-<id>/vi-cancel-<id> buttons on i.status === 'completed' && !i._readonly, and loadOnline sets _readonly=true for every online row (line 76). PASS by code inspection.

T8 Customer upload (VendorCustomers.jsx lines 19-46, 130-138): vc-upload button triggers hidden vc-upload-input, handleUpload uses xlsx to parse .csv/.xlsx and calls saveCustomer for each row. vc-total-spent tile (line 101) uses customers.reduce (unfiltered list). PASS by code inspection.
T9 Right-click deterrent (Layout.jsx lines 114-128): useEffect adds document contextmenu and keydown listeners preventing F12, Ctrl+U/S/P, Ctrl+Shift+I/J/C. PASS by code inspection.

Code-quality nit: displayPayLabel (VendorSales.jsx line 36) treats generic 'paid' as 'Online'; if raw status is exactly 'paid' this could mis-classify a POS paid-cash cloud-mirror row, but current flow drops cloud mirror at source so low risk.

Code-quality nit: VendorInvoices.jsx line 66 hard-codes payment mode as 'cash' for COD and 'upi' otherwise when converting online orders to invoice-rows. This is inconsistent with VendorSales.jsx displayPayLabel which shows 'COD'/'Online'/'Wallet'. Invoices list will therefore display 'Cash' for a COD web order instead of 'COD', unlike the Sales dashboard. Consider aligning.
